summary: Western Digital filed an 8-K disclosing privately negotiated exchange agreements with holders of its 3.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028. Holders will exchange ~$858.4M aggregate principal for cash equal to principal plus accrued interest, plus shares of common stock valued based on VWAP over June 3-4, 2026. The exchange effectively retires debt and issues equity in a liability management transaction. No board recommendation or advisor named. The transaction is structured as a separate negotiated exchange, not a tender offer to all holders. Closing expected on or after June 5, 2026. Watch for shareholder dilution and impact on balance sheet leverage.
